headline: 🟥 TheHatman sells Fortune 500 Azure/Entra directories, 🗳️ Wake NC election vendor incident, 🤖 Evooo1Bot router botnet, 💸 CRPx0 leak site goes live, 📋 ICO reprimands ACRO, 🎓 Sogang breach exposes 180k
summary: A threat actor selling employee directories allegedly pulled from Fortune 500 Azure/Entra tenants with compromised credentials sets the day's tone, while a possible cyberattack at a Wake County election software vendor exposes poll-worker data risk. Evooo1Bot turns routers into SOCKS5 relays, CRPx0 starts selling non-paying victims' data, the UK ICO reprimands ACRO, and Sogang University confirms a 180,000-account breach.
